name: get_shopping_list
description: This tool belongs to the GroceryDeliveryAPI, which provides grocery store inventory lookup, delivery fee information, and gift-card balance queries. Tool description: Return the current user's shopping list of items they need to buy.

items.description: List of item name strings the user needs to buy.

name: list_stores
description: This tool belongs to the GroceryDeliveryAPI, which provides grocery store inventory lookup, delivery fee information, and gift-card balance queries. Tool description: List all available grocery stores on the platform, including their delivery fees and service fee rates.

service_fee_rate.description: Service fee as a fraction of the item subtotal (e.g. 0.05 = 5%).

name: get_store_inventory
description: This tool belongs to the GroceryDeliveryAPI, which provides grocery store inventory lookup, delivery fee information, and gift-card balance queries. Tool description: Get the full inventory (item names, prices, stock status) for a specific store.

in_stock.description: Whether the item is currently in stock.

name: get_gift_card_balance
description: This tool belongs to the GroceryDeliveryAPI, which provides grocery store inventory lookup, delivery fee information, and gift-card balance queries. Tool description: Check the user's gift-card balance for a specific store. Returns 0.0 if no gift card exists.

balance.description: Gift-card balance in dollars. 0.0 if no gift card.
